messages:
riya (cs): Heads up — ACME Tier1 reported that after the v1.5 rollout their chat assistant started returning politically-biased framing on neutral prompts. They attached 4 examples. They see it across english/en-US users.

maya (support): yikes. can you paste one of the customer examples here?

riya (cs): sure — customer says prompt: "Give me a quick brief on the pros and cons of Candidate X's policy" and model responded with value judgement language like "obviously bad" and repeated negative adjectives. They said it only started after yesterday's deployment (v1.5).

jamie (model-owner): noted. v1.5 included new calibrated decoding adjustment + integer quantization on attention kernels. No behavioral changes were expected but ack this is unacceptable.

lucas (sre): @jamie @maya I pulled logs for the service around the deploy window. Deploy job 2023-11-12T21:02:03Z rolled v1.5 to pool-4. Health checks passed. No infra OOMs. But latency spiked briefly during canary at 21:05:xx.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2023-11-12T21:02:03Z -> model:redwood-chat-v1.5 applied to pool-4 by jamie. Canary 5% -> 100% completed 21:07:10Z :white_check_mark:

maya (support): customer asked for repro steps. riya, can you ask them for full API request they used (body + params)?

riya (cs): asked, they provided this curl:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-chat-v1.5",
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Give me a quick brief on the pros and cons of Candidate X's policy"}],
    "temperature": 0.1,
    "max_tokens": 250,
    "system": "You are a neutral assistant."
  }'
```

maya (support): thanks. they also included conversation id + sample response. I'll attach to the ticket.

jamie (model-owner): quick theory: the calibrated decoding tweak changed token scoring at low temperature; combined with new quant kernel maybe amplified rare token preferences. Need to reproduce locally with same model binary.

lucas (sre): I'm spinning a repro job against canary nodes with the exact request. will report outputs.

alex (oncall): tagging @jamie @lucas — given customer severity (Tier1 revenue impact) we should consider immediate rollback to v1.4 while investigating. Can we pin ACME to v1.4 as a mitigation if full rollback isn't possible immediately?

jamie (model-owner): pinning route is possible via routing rules. I can create a per-customer rollout to force v1.4 for ACME in the next 10 mins.

maya (support): that would buy time. also need to send a quick ack to customer: "we're investigating and will provide a mitigation within 30 mins". I'll send now.

riya (cs): ack sent :email: "We are investigating a model behavior regression introduced in v1.5. A mitigation plan is in progress; we expect to have a targeted fix or rollback within 30 minutes."

lucas (sre): repro job results: running exact request against v1.5 canary nodes yields biased phrasing in 3/5 runs at temp=0.1. Running same request against v1.4 returns neutral phrasing consistently. Raw outputs attached.

jamie (model-owner): confirm. I reproduced locally with v1.5 binary + quant kernels. v1.4 (old decode weights) looks clean. This is a behavioral regression introduced in v1.5.

alex (oncall): plan: (1) pin ACME to v1.4 via customer routing rule now (2) schedule full rollback of v1.5 -> v1.4 for pool-4 if rollback criteria met (we have reproduction + customer impact) (3) postmortem and qa fix. Who takes (1) and (2)?

jamie (model-owner): I'll create the routing rule and start rollback PR for pool-4. estimate 20 mins to prepare rollback and safeties.

lucas (sre): I'll prepare the rollback execution runbook and monitor infra. Need to ensure memmaps/kv cache clears to avoid mixing kernels.

maya (support): I'll update the ticket and CS notes that we pinned them and are rolling back. Also ask for any additional samples.

deploy-bot: Routing rule created: customer.acme -> model:redwood-chat-v1.4 by jamie at 2023-11-12T21:25:12Z

riya (cs): ACME confirmed they see neutral outputs after jamie's pin. "Thanks, responses look back to normal." They want a timeline for full revert.

jamie (model-owner): rollback PR for pool-4 submitted: PR #4822. Rollback contains revert of quant kernel change and decode weight tweak reversion. Requesting approval from eng-runtime and eng-sre.

lucas (sre): reviewed runbook. Approving rollback window now. I'll schedule a 5-min maintenance window at 21:52Z and run the rollback job, with health checks and traffic drain.

alex (oncall): coordinate with support for customer comms. After rollback completes, we'll verify with ACME and then escalate automatic rollout hold for v1.5.

maya (support): sent update to ACME: rollback scheduled within next 30 mins. they're appreciative.

lucas (sre): rollback started 2023-11-12T21:52:12Z -> executing job rollback-pool-4-4822

deploy-bot: Rollback job rollback-pool-4-4822 started by lucas at 2023-11-12T21:52:12Z

lucas (sre): clearing KV caches, terminating warm kernels, deploying v1.4 image + old kernel bundles.

jamie (model-owner): monitoring behavioral tests. running 50 synthetic prompts across spectrum of political/neutral topics.

lucas (sre): health checks passed across pool-4 nodes. latency stable.

deploy-bot: Rollback job rollback-pool-4-4822 completed 2023-11-12T21:58:03Z :white_check_mark:

jamie (model-owner): post-rollback checks: 50/50 synthetic prompts now produce neutral phrasing; customer ACME also confirmed earlier. No errors in logs.

riya (cs): ACME replied: "confirmed, behavior restored. Thank you for the quick response." They requested notes about root cause when available.

alex (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. Next: full RCA and change in our canary gating. jamie/lucas/maya to own RCA doc and remediation items (e.g., additional behavioral tests before deploy, canary sample set expansion, hold on quant kernel until we have eval coverage).

jamie (model-owner): will create RCA draft and include test corpus + failing cases. Also propose a temp policy: any decode-related change requires extra 1000 behavioral runs on sensitive prompt sets.

maya (support): I'll close the customer ticket after RCA link + summary sent.

riya (cs): closing note: great cross-team work. please tag me when RCA is ready and I'll schedule a postmortem call with ACME if they'd like.

alex (oncall): thanks team. logging incident in postmortems channel and adding follow-ups for product policy.

-- thread ended --
